lcd_reference: LCD Hospice Eligibility Determination – Pulmonary Disease

eligibility_result.reason: Parameterized disease-specific LCD criteria for pulmonary disease.

criteria.description: Disabling dyspnea at rest is present (for example poor bronchodilator response with markedly decreased functional capacity or FEV1 less than 30 percent predicted, if available)

Progression of end-stage pulmonary disease is documented (for example increasing ER visits, pulmonary infection hospitalizations, respiratory failure, increasing physician home visits, or serial FEV1 decline greater than 40 ml/year)
Hypoxemia at rest on room air with pO2 less than or equal to 55 mmHg
O2 saturation is less than or equal to 88 percent
Hypercapnia with pCO2 greater than or equal to 50 mmHg
Right heart failure secondary to pulmonary disease (cor pulmonale)
Unintentional progressive weight loss of at least 10 percent over the last six months
Resting tachycardia greater than 100 per minute

clinical_notes: The source form contains nested any-of items inside the severe chronic lung disease block; those are represented as aggregate facts to keep engine changes minimal.
source_document: COPD, Respiratory failure with hypoxia, hypercapnia.pdf
